guidance.relation_criterion: Resolve every definition route, alternative, and exception. Explicit-identification is Entailment only when every protected route requires marking, designation, oral identification, written confirmation, or another express act by the discloser. A blanket category, protection regardless of designation, or a route based merely on nature, context, recipient knowledge, or reasonable understanding is Contradiction. Technical-only is Entailment only if every included subject is technical; any business, financial, personnel, customer, contractual, marketing, operational, or similarly nontechnical subject is Contradiction. Oral coverage requires express oral, verbal, or spoken disclosure language, or universal form language that plainly includes nonwritten disclosure. A written-confirmation condition attached to oral disclosure still supports coverage. Visual inspection or demonstration alone, access to property, information learned from employees, discussions, and communications without a form rule do not establish verbally conveyed information. Agreement-confidentiality requires an operative duty protecting the agreement, its existence or terms, negotiations, transaction discussions, or their status; a definition without an applicable confidentiality duty is insufficient.
guidance.evidence_criterion: For universal identification and technical-exclusivity choices, include every independently decisive definition route or category and the lead-in establishing inclusion. For oral coverage, select the oral or universal-form language plus any grammatically necessary definition lead-in or confirmation condition; exclude inspection, access, source, meeting, and communication language that does not establish oral form. For agreement-confidentiality, select both the protected subject and operative nondisclosure or publicity restriction when separated. Retain independently responsive repeated provisions, but omit examples that do not affect the choice, headings, recitals, entire-agreement clauses, and unrelated duties.

guidance.relation_criterion: Resolve endpoint disposition, survival, and retained possession separately. Return-or-destroy is Entailment only when termination, expiration, completion, abandonment, failure to proceed, cessation, rejection, or another relationship-ending event activates the disposition duty. A request-only duty does not entail this hypothesis, although an endpoint branch disjoined from a request branch does. Survival requires language continuing an obligation after an endpoint or expressly preserving it despite return, destruction, or another terminating event; a fixed agreement term, remedy, severability, or general enforceability is insufficient. Post-disposition possession is Entailment when the applicable regime expressly permits or requires retention for legal, compliance, archival, backup, evidentiary, or infeasibility reasons. An exhaustive command covering all protected information and copies without a retention route is Contradiction whether activated by an endpoint or a request. A command limited to specified media, documents, or other nonexhaustive material does not resolve possession of unaddressed information.
guidance.evidence_criterion: For return-or-destroy, select the complete endpoint trigger and disposition command, including alternative return or destruction branches; omit request-only provisions and collateral certification, timing, or notice unless inseparable. For survival, select the continuation language and referenced duties needed to identify what continues. For permitted retention, select every independently operative retention or infeasibility route and the minimum governing disposition language. For Contradiction, select the exhaustive command and language establishing its all-information or all-copy scope, including its trigger when necessary. Do not substitute remedies, fixed durations, or ordinary confidentiality clauses.

guidance.relation_criterion: Test present authority to create a new copy, reproduction, duplicate, record, written reduction, or comparable embodiment. Entailment requires affirmative permission, including copying strictly or reasonably necessary for the stated purpose or authorized recipients. A narrow copying right still counts when embedded in a no-license, intellectual-property, confidentiality, or use provision. A prohibition with only a future-consent mechanism is Contradiction, as is a categorical ban on copying, duplicating, replicating, or reproducing; the ban remains responsive when bundled with decompilation or reverse engineering. Do not infer creation from use, access, delivery, possession, sharing, returning existing copies, retaining an existing archival copy, or references to copies already made. Backup language supports Entailment only when it affirmatively authorizes creation or maintenance of backup copies. Otherwise return NotMentioned.
guidance.evidence_criterion: Select the operative copying verb, actor, modality, and controlling purpose or recipient condition. If permission is an exception within a prohibition, include both parts needed to resolve the exception; if an affirmative copying right appears inside another clause, select that responsive portion and its necessary scope. For a bundled prohibition, select the copying prohibition and only the shared lead-in needed to identify its actor or object. Exclude return provisions, existing-copy references, retention exceptions, general use or disclosure permissions, and adjacent security, ownership, or reverse-engineering language that does not govern copying.

guidance.relation_criterion: Keep provenance routes distinct. Independent-development Entailment requires express development, creation, or derivation by the receiving party independently and ordinarily without use, access, reference, or reliance on protected information; prior possession, permitted use, warranties, or third-party receipt are not substitutes. Third-party-acquisition Entailment requires the receiving party to receive, obtain, or learn the information from an external source entitled to disclose it and not bound by the relevant confidentiality restriction. Disclosure by the disclosing party to someone else is not acquisition by the receiver. An affirmative freedom to develop or acquire similar products, services, or technology also supports its matching hypothesis. An express ban on the route is Contradiction; absence is NotMentioned.
guidance.evidence_criterion: Select the exact provenance prong and its shared exclusion introduction when the introduction supplies the legal consequence. Include proof, no-use, no-access, lawful-source, right-to-disclose, and no-confidentiality conditions attached to that prong. If a separate freedom-to-develop or freedom-to-acquire clause independently supports the same choice, retain it as redundant responsive evidence. Exclude neighboring public-domain, prior-possession, warranty, disclosure-by-owner, and unrelated provenance prongs.

guidance.relation_criterion: Read the general prohibition and every exception before classifying. Employee-sharing is Entailment when an operative provision permits at least some receiving-party employees to receive protected information, even subject to need-to-know, designation, undertaking, training, or recipient-liability conditions. Third-party-sharing is Entailment only for a standing permission covering an external or potentially external class such as agents, consultants, advisers, counsel, contractors, subcontractors, or other representatives. Permission limited to employees, officers, or directors is Contradiction for third-party sharing. A future discretionary-consent procedure is not present permission. Affiliate status alone or an affiliate's employees does not necessarily establish an external professional class. Silence is NotMentioned; an exhaustive outsider ban without an applicable exception is Contradiction.
guidance.evidence_criterion: For Entailment, select the operative permission or whitelist, the responsive recipient class, and every attached need-to-know, purpose, undertaking, or responsibility condition; include a governing introduction only when it supplies permission or actor. For Contradiction, select the general prohibition together with the exclusive whitelist or consent gate that closes the tested class. Retain separately operative recipient permissions, but omit security rules, ownership clauses, third-party-beneficiary text, and unrelated use restrictions.

guidance.relation_criterion: Entailment requires operative language withholding a license, title, interest, ownership, immunity, intellectual-property right, or other right in the confidential information, or reserving exclusive ownership in a way that directly denies recipient acquisition. Consider scoped exceptions and any affirmative grant. Contradiction requires an actual grant of a right in the same protected object; a limited permission to use information for the transaction or stated purpose is not by itself such a grant. Do not infer no-rights from confidentiality, nondisclosure, limited use, entire-agreement, no-warranty, remedy, or no-commitment language. If neither grant nor withholding is expressed, return NotMentioned.
guidance.evidence_criterion: Select every independently operative ownership-reservation or no-license/no-right sentence contributing to the result, including distinct confidential-information and intellectual-property provisions. For Contradiction, select the actual affirmative grant and its scope. Exclude permitted-use clauses, disclosure mechanics, warranties, accuracy disclaimers, commercialization language, remedies, and administrative provisions unless they themselves grant or withhold the relevant right.

guidance.relation_criterion: Match actor, object, conduct, polarity, trigger, and exceptions. Limited-use Entailment requires an operative sole-purpose, necessary-purpose, or no-other-purpose restriction; nondisclosure alone is insufficient. Compelled-disclosure notice requires notice or consultation tied to law, regulation, subpoena, court, government, or comparable compulsory process; incident or breach reporting is different. Reverse-engineering Entailment requires an express ban on reverse engineering, decompiling, disassembling, or a stated equivalent directed at software, products, prototypes, tangible objects, or protected information. Because the hypothesis is prohibitory, such a ban supports rather than contradicts it. No-solicitation Entailment requires an express ban on soliciting, inducing, enticing, employing, hiring, retaining, or contracting for services of the specified employees or representatives; contact controls, advertising rules, noncompetition, and nondisclosure are not substitutes. Express permission for the same conduct is Contradiction; silence or neighboring regulation is NotMentioned.
guidance.evidence_criterion: For limited use, select each independently operative use restriction and any incorporated purpose or exception needed to resolve its scope, excluding adjacent disclosure and security duties. For compelled notice, select the compulsory trigger and notice or consultation duty, including independently operative pre- or post-disclosure notice; omit disclosure limits unless inseparable. For reverse engineering, select the exact prohibition and object. For solicitation, select each responsive solicitation, hiring, employment, retention, or inducement ban plus shared duration and operative exceptions. Do not add neighboring noncompetition, standstill, contact, publicity, copying, ownership, or remedy provisions unless they grammatically supply the responsive rule.
